I need to test the server for race error transactions in Express. It seems I should throw and catch these errors to ensure things work as intended. The tests need a temporary environment that can handle server-fixed module caches. An easier integration might be using a bash server with a fresh database and curl in Python. I'll also need to make sure to update the manifest and include a gitignore in the task for frontend collaboration.
